company.description: Belong is a location-based group app that allows local people to share, learn and gain knowledge on the topics they care most about. Whatever your interest, there is an organised and moderated community for you on ASKWHO. Belong is a social discovery platform designed to help people build meaningful local connections through shared interests, activities, and communities. The app enables users to discover events, join groups, and meet like-minded individuals nearby. Belong focuses on fostering real-world interactions and community engagement, creating a digital space that encourages friendships, networking, and social experiences in urban environments.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $1,500,000, or 42.86% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,296,529 to $17,658,508, a 2.42x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 58 (-4 over 90 days) and market heat at 50 (-7).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
